title: The pieces of the door's calls and replies
description: Definitions the call and reply schemas name by $ref. This document validates nothing on its own.

actor.description: An actor reference: ed25519: and the public key in 64 lowercase hex digits.

hash.description: A typed hash: sha256: and 64 lowercase hex digits. An Accord id, a receipt id and a question id are typed hashes.

timestamp.description: A time in whole seconds, UTC, with Z: 2026-11-18T09:00:00Z.

nonce.description: 16 random bytes in lowercase hex, never sent twice within 120 seconds.

base64.description: Standard base64, with padding, of exact bytes.

sig.description: The call's signature: standard base64 of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the DSSE pre-authentication encoding of the payload type application/vnd.placket.call+json and the call's canonical bytes.

wait.description: How many whole seconds the door may hold the call until it has something to return; absent or 0, it replies at once.

cursor.description: An opaque value a questions reply carries. Passed back as after, it asks only for the questions opened after the last one that reply carried.

code.description: A code: lowercase letters and digits in words joined by single hyphens.

receipt.description: A receipt, as the mediator signed it: a frozen format (spec/schema/), carried here as the door carries it.

outcome.description: One receipt the call made: its verdict, reason and id, and the receipt.

refusal.description: A call refused: by the mediator, rejection, what the caller did wrong, or error, what the caller's program did wrong; or by the door, door, a code about the call itself. Exactly one of the three.

empty.description: Nothing to return: get with nothing queued, or result while the question is open.

outcomes.description: The receipts the call made, or a closed question's: outcome, and release, the release's, when the answer had one.
